title: Remove CapCut from the automatic packaging checkpoint
description: Align the renderer-side Semi-automatic preview chain with the V1 output contract so QA and Packaging Export run after final-preview approval without requiring an optional CapCut Draft.
businessContext: The main-process orchestrator, workflow registry, and Export screen already treat CapCut Draft as optional, but the reusable renderer workflow helper still runs CapCut as a mandatory manual checkpoint.
acceptanceCriteria: runPreviewChain runs QA and Packaging Export directly after final-preview approval when no CapCut Draft exists.
runPreviewChain does not invoke CapCut, while an already-approved CapCut artifact remains compatible with packaging.
Progress totals and messages describe QA plus Packaging Export rather than a mandatory CapCut checkpoint.
Focused Semi-automatic workflow tests, typecheck, and diff checks pass.
humanEscalationConditions: Removing the automatic CapCut checkpoint would break explicit optional CapCut export or package invalidation semantics.
